### Phase 1: DGP-related charts

1) Default rate per year


```{r}


# ── Aggregate by observation year ────────────────────────────────────
year_stats <- dat %>%
  group_by(obs_year) %>%
  summarise(
    n_obs        = n(),
    n_defaults   = sum(default),
    default_rate = mean(default),
    .groups      = "drop"
  )

# ── Scaling factor for dual axis ────────────────────────────────────
# Maps the right-axis (count) to the left-axis (rate) range
max_rate  <- max(year_stats$default_rate) * 1.15
max_count <- max(year_stats$n_obs) * 1.15
scale_factor <- max_rate / max_count

# ── Plot ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggplot(year_stats, aes(x = obs_year)) +
  # Bars: firm-year count (scaled to rate axis)
  geom_col(aes(y = n_obs * scale_factor),
           fill = "grey75", width = 0.7) +
  # Line: default rate
  geom_line(aes(y = default_rate),
            color = "#1a3a5c", linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = default_rate),
             color = "#1a3a5c", size = 2.2) +
  # Dual axes
  scale_y_continuous(
    name   = "Default Rate",
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 0.1),
    limits = c(0, max_rate),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / scale_factor,
                        name   = "Number of Firms",
                        labels = scales::comma_format())
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(min(year_stats$obs_year), max(year_stats$obs_year), by = 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Simulated Default Rate and Portfolio Size by Year",
    x     = "Year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
  )

# ── Optional: print the table too ───────────────────────────────────
cat("\n── Year-level summary ──\n")
print(year_stats, n = 30)

```

### Function Checks Before Impairment / Modeling

```{r}

# ── DGP Checks ────────────────────────────────

# Do deteriorating firms actually have rising debt-equity and falling interest coverage over time?
det_firms <- dat[dat$trajectory == "deteriorating", ]
cat("Deteriorating firms — mean dte year 1:", 
    round(mean(det_firms$debt_to_equity[det_firms$years_on_book == 1]), 3), "\n")
cat("Deteriorating firms — mean dte year 3+:", 
    round(mean(det_firms$debt_to_equity[det_firms$years_on_book >= 3]), 3), "\n")
cat("Deteriorating firms — mean ic year 1:", 
    round(mean(det_firms$interest_cov[det_firms$years_on_book == 1]), 3), "\n")
cat("Deteriorating firms — mean ic year 3+:", 
    round(mean(det_firms$interest_cov[det_firms$years_on_book >= 3]), 3), "\n")


# ── Are sector rates / trends accurate? ────────────────────────────────

# Overall sector default rates (firm-year level)
cat("Default rates per sector (1: services / 2: gastro / 3: manufacturing):\n", 
    tapply(dat$default, dat$sector, mean), "\n",
    "Target: sector 1 ≈ 0.020, sector 2 ≈ 0.036, sector 3 ≈ 0.023\n")

# Gastro trend over time
cat("Over-time default rate increases for Gastro per year (note low base on the tails):\n", 
    round(tapply(dat$default[dat$sector == 2], dat$obs_year[dat$sector == 2], mean), 3), "\n")
```

```{r}

build_calibration_data <- function(models,
                                   eval_data,
                                   formula,
                                   model_type = c("glm", "xgboost")) {

  model_type <- match.arg(model_type)
  response   <- all.vars(formula)[1]
  predictors <- all.vars(formula)[-1]
  actual     <- eval_data[[response]]

  # Same grade boundaries as assign_pd_grades()
  grade_breaks <- c(0, 0.00001, 0.0006, 0.0011, 0.003,
                    0.007, 0.015, 0.03, 0.08, 0.15, 1.0)
  grade_labels <- as.character(1:10)

  cal_list <- vector("list", length(models))
  names(cal_list) <- names(models)

  for (key in names(models)) {

    mod <- models[[key]]

    if (model_type == "glm") {
      pd_pred <- predict(mod, newdata = eval_data, type = "response")
    } else {
      X <- as.matrix(eval_data[, predictors, drop = FALSE])
      pd_pred <- predict(mod, xgb.DMatrix(data = X))
    }

    grade <- cut(pd_pred,
                 breaks = grade_breaks,
                 labels = grade_labels,
                 include.lowest = TRUE,
                 right = TRUE)

    tmp <- data.frame(pd_pred = pd_pred, actual = actual,
                      grade = as.integer(as.character(grade)))

    agg <- aggregate(cbind(pd_pred, actual) ~ grade, data = tmp, FUN = mean)
    counts <- aggregate(actual ~ grade, data = tmp, FUN = length)
    names(counts)[2] <- "n"
    agg <- merge(agg, counts, by = "grade")

    names(agg)[names(agg) == "pd_pred"] <- "mean_pred_pd"
    names(agg)[names(agg) == "actual"]  <- "obs_default_rate"

    # Parse key
    stage <- ifelse(key == "clean", "clean",
                    ifelse(grepl("^imp_", key), "impaired", "prepared"))
    condition <- ifelse(key == "clean", "clean",
                        sub("^imp_|^prep_", "", key))

    agg$key        <- key
    agg$stage      <- stage
    agg$condition  <- condition
    agg$model_type <- model_type

    cal_list[[key]] <- agg
  }

  cal_df <- do.call(rbind, cal_list)
  rownames(cal_df) <- NULL
  cal_df
}

# ── Build calibration data for both model types ────────────────────────

glm_cal <- build_calibration_data(
  models     = glm_results$models,
  eval_data  = dat,
  formula    = pd_formula,
  model_type = "glm"
)

xgb_cal <- build_calibration_data(
  models     = xgb_results$models,
  eval_data  = dat,
  formula    = pd_formula,
  model_type = "xgboost"
)

all_cal <- rbind(glm_cal, xgb_cal)

# Filter to clean + prepared only (what a practitioner would deploy)
cal_plot_data <- all_cal[all_cal$stage %in% c("clean", "prepared"), ]

# For prepared conditions, parse type + severity for faceting
cal_plot_data$type <- ifelse(
  cal_plot_data$condition == "clean", "clean",
  sub("_mild$|_severe$", "", cal_plot_data$condition)
)
cal_plot_data$severity <- ifelse(
  cal_plot_data$condition == "clean", "none",
  ifelse(grepl("severe", cal_plot_data$condition), "severe", "mild")
)

# Label for faceting: one panel per impairment type
cal_plot_data$facet_label <- ifelse(
  cal_plot_data$condition == "clean", "clean",
  cal_plot_data$condition
)

condition_order <- c("clean",
                     "mcar_mild", "mcar_severe",
                     "mar_mild",  "mar_severe",
                     "mnar_mild", "mnar_severe",
                     "noise_mild", "noise_severe",
                     "impl_mild", "impl_severe")

cal_plot_data$facet_label <- factor(cal_plot_data$facet_label,
                                    levels = condition_order)

ggplot(cal_plot_data,
       aes(x = mean_pred_pd, y = obs_default_rate,
           color = model_type, shape = stage)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ facet_label, ncol = 3, scales = "free") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(glm = "#3498db", xgboost = "#e67e22")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(clean = 17, prepared = 15)) +
  labs(title    = "Calibration Plot: Predicted PD vs. Observed Default Rate by Grade",
       subtitle = "Dashed line = perfect calibration | Clean (triangle) vs. Prepared (square)",
       x = "Mean Predicted PD (within grade)",
       y = "Observed Default Rate (within grade)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "bottom")



```


```{r}

# ── Grade migration heatmap ─────────────────────────────────────────

# Get clean-data grade per firm
clean_grades <- glm_grades %>%
  filter(stage == "clean") %>%
  select(firm_id, clean_grade = grade)

# Join clean grade onto impaired + prepared
migration <- glm_grades %>%
  filter(stage != "clean") %>%
  inner_join(clean_grades, by = "firm_id") %>%
  count(condition, stage, clean_grade, grade, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(condition, stage) %>%
  mutate(share = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

migration$condition <- factor(migration$condition, levels = condition_order)
migration$stage     <- factor(migration$stage, levels = c("impaired", "prepared"))


# One plot per impairment type = 2 rows (mild/severe) × 2 cols (impaired/prepared)
# → 5 plots of 4 panels each, each panel is big enough to read

for (imp_type in c("mcar", "mar", "mnar", "noise", "impl")) {

  p <- migration %>%
    filter(grepl(imp_type, condition)) %>%
    mutate(severity = ifelse(grepl("severe", condition), "severe", "mild")) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = factor(grade), y = factor(clean_grade), fill = share)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    # Diagonal highlight instead of geom_abline
    geom_tile(data = . %>% filter(as.numeric(as.character(grade)) ==
                                   as.numeric(as.character(clean_grade))),
              aes(x = factor(grade), y = factor(clean_grade)),
              fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "steelblue",
                        labels = scales::percent_format()) +
    facet_grid(severity ~ stage) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    labs(title = paste0("Grade Migration: ", toupper(imp_type)),
         x = "Grade after impairment / preparation",
         y = "Grade on clean data",
         fill = "Share") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          aspect.ratio = 1)

  print(p)
}


```
